title: 跨模型校准：同一套件、同一对臂，换一个模型
hypothesis: 机制结论与模型无关；若不同模型给出不同方向，则任何单模型结论都必须标注模型身份
not_run_reason: preregistration lands before the paid run so the model, arms and rule cannot be chosen after seeing results

task_cluster_definition.cluster: single_agent vs adaptive_tournament_2, same suite and verifier as E07, model gpt-6-luna vs the recorded gemini-3.8-flash run
task_cluster_definition.independence: task is the sampling unit; the two models are not resampled, they are two recorded conditions

model_identity_observability.requested: gpt-6-luna (cobblemon endpoint, chat-completions); backend revision not observable
model_identity_observability.claim_limit: same public label in the same window; a cross-model difference is a difference between two recorded conditions, not a property of a weight file

quality_margin.rule: a mechanism whose direction differs between the two models is reported as model-dependent; it is not averaged into one number

noise_and_power_plan.plan: 12 runs on gpt-6-luna (6 tasks x 2 arms), compared against the recorded 12 runs on gemini-3.8-flash with the same suite and arms
noise_and_power_plan.interval: 95% cluster bootstrap within each model; the between-model comparison is descriptive

cache_order_design.order: randomized within blocks; cache state recorded per run

stopping_rule: stop at 12 runs; do not rerun to chase a direction

holdout_policy.retire_after: not used: this is a calibration run, not a confirmatory claim
holdout_policy.retirement_action: the holdout stays unused and available
